name: Kimi-User
description: Moonshot AI's user-triggered fetcher for Kimi, which retrieves a page when a person asks Kimi to summarise it or answers a question needing live web retrieval. Moonshot states it is not used for automated bulk crawling and that, because the actions are user-triggered, robots.txt rules may not directly apply.

instances: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko); compatible; Kimi-User/1.0; +https://www.kimi.com/policies/kimi-crawlers
